note: extreme registers; not physically meaningful cutoffs

layout.input_frames.bin: N*h*w little-endian uint32 words; byte0=B byte1=G byte2=R byte3=0 (uint8)
layout.expected_output.bin: N*h*w words; byte0=B byte1=G byte2=R (int8 two's complement), byte3=0
layout.expected_state.bin: state_frames x [L_hi, L_lo], each h*w*3 int32 LE (Q16.16), pixel-interleaved B,G,R, row-major; state AFTER that frame
layout.init: frames listed in init_frames are sent with init=1; their output is all zeros
